user_template: Suggest 3 short things {speaker} might say or do right after this, still part of the same {activity}.{hint_clause}
- Each phrase names a concrete next action in the routine or exchange (a thing you do or say), not a description, feeling, or comparison.
- Do not use similes or metaphors — state the action plainly.
- Each phrase should work as something the speaker would actually say in the moment — short announcement, invitation, or request form, not decorative narration.
- Not paraphrases of the original phrase, and not each other — 3 genuinely different steps.
